about_the_game:
Operation Anatolia: The Great Offensive is an online multiplayer first-person shooter that immerses you in the epic battles of the Turkish War of Independence (1919–1923). Step into the shoes of nationalist fighters and experience the struggle for freedom as you engage in intense tactical combat across historically inspired battlefields.

Fight in the Great Offensive

Relive the decisive campaign that turned the tide of the conflict. Choose your team as Turkish or Greek forces and coordinate with your team.

Online Multiplayer

Join 20 to 32 player matches and work as a team to seize the victory.

Authentic Weapons & Equipment 

Use rifles, machine guns, and tactical gear from historically accurate post-World War I era.

Dynamic Battlefields

From Anatolian hills to key strategic towns, fight across varied maps designed for both strategy and tactical action.

Team Based Combat

Coordinate with allies, capture and hold objectives. Push your team to victory. 

Future Expansion

Expect additional fronts, including the French and British theaters, as the game grows.

Whether you’re a history enthusiast or a competitive shooter fan, Operation Anatolia offers a unique blend of historical authenticity and engaging online gameplay.

Operation Anatolia is developed with Unreal Engine 4.
